description: Live numbers of the TrueNorth (NORTH) chain: height, blocks of the last 24 hours, an estimate of the network's hashrate, the block reward, the coins issued so far and the next halving; and of the Polarka pool: its hashrate, miners, fee, payout scheme and blocks found. Read from the node and the pool at polarka.org; hashrates are estimates. Takes no arguments. Use it to answer how big or busy the network is, or before mining.
name: north_network
title: TrueNorth network and Polarka pool, now
